title: Garlicky Smashed Cucumber Salad with Chilli Oil
summary: A refreshing Chinese-style smashed cucumber salad with punchy garlic, tangy rice vinegar, soy, sesame and a warm chilli oil dressing. It makes a light vegan lunch or a crisp side for noodles or rice.
steps: Lay the cucumbers on a board and smack them firmly with a rolling pin or the flat side of a heavy knife until they split and crack. Cut into rough 3–4 cm chunks.
Put the cucumber in a colander, sprinkle with the salt, toss well and leave to drain for 10 minutes. The pieces should soften slightly and release watery liquid.
Meanwhile, put the grated garlic, sliced chilli, chilli powder, sesame seeds and sliced spring onions in a heatproof bowl.

Heat the vegetable oil in a small pan over medium-high heat for 1–2 minutes until shimmering but not smoking. Carefully pour it over the garlic and chilli mixture; it should sizzle and smell fragrant.
Stir in the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sugar and black pepper until the sugar dissolves.
Shake off any excess liquid from the cucumber, then add it to the dressing. Toss thoroughly so the cracked edges catch the chilli oil.
Let the salad sit for 5 minutes, then toss again and serve at room temperature, spooning any garlicky chilli oil from the bowl over the top.
